chainBinding.note: The seq-5 entry is declared and approved here complete in sealed-entry form, but that is not appendability: appendPrerequisites lists the validator and chain-root amendments an actual append to the live EFFECTIVE_AUTHORITY_CHAIN_REF still needs, none of which this M0 package performs because tools/lib/kernel-effective-authority-chain.mjs is outside this package's ten-file allowlist. The normalized text lives once, inside successorEntry, so no second copy can drift.
